title: Reorganize String
description: Rearrange characters in a string such that no two adjacent characters are the same.
pseudocode:
1. Count character frequencies.
2. Use a max-heap to store characters by frequency.
3. Poll the most frequent char and append to result.
4. Save the char to put back after the next step to avoid adjacency.
fullDescription:
Given a string s, rearrange the characters of s so that any two adjacent characters are not the same.

Return any possible rearrangement of s or return "" if not possible.

 

Example 1:

Input: s = "aab"
Output: "aba"

Example 2:

Input: s = "aaab"
Output: ""

 

Constraints:

  • 1 <= s.length <= 500
  • s consists of lowercase English letters.
